name: @blip/worker
description: Blip Cloudflare Worker — Cloudflare-native monitoring mode. One Worker runs checks on a Cron Trigger, stores results in D1, and serves the dashboard + /data/*.json API.

scripts.build: npm ci --prefix "$npm_config_local_prefix" --workspace @blip/dashboard && (test "$(uname)" != Linux || npm install --prefix "$npm_config_local_prefix" --no-save --ignore-scripts @rollup/rollup-linux-x64-gnu@4.62.0 @cloudflare/workerd-linux-64@1.20260617.1) && npm run build --workspace @blip/dashboard && npm run gen-config && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.deploy: npm ci --prefix "$npm_config_local_prefix" --workspace @blip/dashboard && (test "$(uname)" != Linux || npm install --prefix "$npm_config_local_prefix" --no-save --ignore-scripts @rollup/rollup-linux-x64-gnu@4.62.0 @cloudflare/workerd-linux-64@1.20260617.1) && npm run build --workspace @blip/dashboard && npm run gen-config && wrangler deploy
